difficulty_reason: For separated X'_2 -> X, morphisms X'_1 -> X'_2 are graphs: closed immersions i with pr_1 ∘ i an isomorphism (semi-diagonal lemma); the same characterization holds over U, V, and Y; triples of compatible morphisms give compatible triples of graphs, i.e. an object of the triple category over X'_1 x_X X'_2 whose components are closed immersions; lemma-equivalence-on-affine identifies these with closed immersions of the glued object and lemma-reflects-isomorphisms finishes.
